description: Official centralized metadata repository and REST API for publicly accessible MCP servers.
limitations: Preview status; breaking changes or data resets possible
compatibility: third-party registries implementing the MCP Registry API

free_access.restrictions: Preview; API rate limits and terms apply

source_claims.claim: The official MCP Registry provides a REST API, standardized server.json metadata, DNS-verified namespaces, and installation/configuration information.
The registry is in preview and may experience breaking changes or data resets.
The registry API is served at https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io and publishes an OpenAPI specification.

notes: Use as primary ingestion source for public MCP server metadata; do not treat listing as a security audit.

description: Unified API and catalog for accessing models from multiple providers, including free model variants and a free-model router.
limitations: Free models have low rate limits and changing availability
Platform fee charged on credit purchases
Fallback to paid models can create charges

pricing.billing_unit: Zero token cost; request quotas apply

free_access.classification: Limited free tier plus free model variants
free_access.quotas: 20 requests/minute and 50 requests/day by default; 1,000 requests/day after purchasing at least $10 credits; failed attempts count toward daily cap
free_access.restrictions: Free availability changes; negative balance blocks free models

source_claims.claim: OpenRouter lists 25+ free models and enforces free-model limits of 20 requests/minute and 50/day, rising to 1,000/day after $10 in credits.
OpenRouter implements the OpenAI API specification for /completions and /chat/completions and exposes /api/v1/models.
The openrouter/free router selects free models and falls back only to other free models when used alone.
A :free model fallback array can bill paid models if a free model is unavailable or rate-limited.

unknown_fields: provider-specific data-retention policies for every free endpoint
notes: Refresh /api/v1/models frequently; do not hard-code the free-model catalog.

description: Router that automatically selects an available free OpenRouter model based on requested capabilities.
capabilities: no router or free-model token charge
limitations: Lower rate limits than paid models
Context may be limited to 200,000 tokens for routed models

free_access.classification: Permanently free offering subject to free-model quotas
free_access.restrictions: Free-model rate limits and availability apply

source_claims.claim: The Free Models Router is completely free and falls back only to other free models when used alone.
The router filters free models for capabilities such as image understanding, tool calling, and structured outputs.

notes: Do not present as suitable for production reliability without user-side fallback and monitoring.

description: Anthropic’s terminal coding agent with an extension system comprising skills, subagents, hooks, MCP servers, plugins, and marketplaces.
limitations: Extension behavior and synced skills depend on account, version, and feature flags

source_claims.claim: A Claude Code plugin is a directory of skills, agents, hooks, MCP servers, or other components installed as one unit.
Skills are SKILL.md instruction files that Claude can load automatically or invoke through /skill-name.
Marketplaces are repositories or directories with .claude-plugin/marketplace.json; they are catalogs, not hosted stores.

notes: Preserve skill/plugin/MCP-server distinctions in the data model.

description: Terminal coding agent with a plugin system that can modify behavior and manage skills.
limitations: Plugin API details must be validated against the current documentation version

source_claims.claim: OpenCode plugins can modify behavior and add features; the plugin context exposes skill listing and transformation operations.

notes: Requires a dedicated repository/package-registry crawl before publication.

description: Composite evaluation aggregating multiple benchmarks across agents, coding, general capability, and scientific reasoning.
limitations: Not a substitute for task-specific evaluation
Composite weights and component benchmarks change by version

source_claims.claim: Intelligence Index v4.3.2 aggregates ten evaluations and weights agents, coding, general capability, and scientific reasoning.
The methodology describes standardized conditions, zero-shot instruction prompting, judge-based grading, and private held-out components.
Category weights are Agents 30%, Coding 20%, General 30%, and Scientific Reasoning 20%.

notes: Store benchmark version, observation date, and component weights with every imported score.

description: Git-based hosting platform and API for models, datasets, Spaces, model cards, and inference providers.
limitations: API calls subject to Hub-wide rate limits
Model cards and licenses vary by repository
license: Platform terms apply; individual model/dataset licenses vary

source_claims.claim: The Hub hosts over 2M models, 1.5M datasets, and 1.5M AI apps (Spaces).
Hub API endpoints are open and documented through an always-up-to-date OpenAPI Playground and downloadable OpenAPI specification.
All API calls are subject to HF-wide rate limits.

notes: Use as discovery and metadata backbone; verify licenses and model cards per repository.
